** This Table replaces previous versions (USACHPPM March 2006, USACHPPM Aug 2009, July 2010)The air criteria listed in this Table are designed for protection from inhalation and ocular exposures as the most sensitive exposure routes; note that

separate vapor exposure limits for percutaneousvapor absorptionare also officially endorsed by Army for occupational use per ref a3below). Perc vapor values in mg/m3arefor 30 minute skin exposures:  GA = 11.1; GB = 6.0; GD/GF = 1.5; VX = 0.13; H = 0.1.

IDLH:In response to a June 2009 request from U.S.

determination at Pine Bluff (PB), Ark, USACHPPM proposed a protective toxicological-based effective IDLH value of 0.36 mg/m3 for DACASC consideration.  TheUSACHPPM criterionwas endorsed in an OTSG memorandum, Subject New Immediately D
